paras: 02 Days Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR004
Rs.3499/- per person
Day: 01 – Jaipur Pick up and Sightseeing

Welcome to Jaipur! The Pink City! Upon your arrival at Jaipur Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly greeted and transferred to your hotel. After a refreshing breakfast at the hotel, get ready to explore the magnificent attractions of the Pink City, including:
Hawa Mahal: The iconic "Palace of Winds"
City Palace: A stunning mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture
Jantar Mantar: The famous astronomical observatory
Jal Mahal: The picture perfect "Water Palace"
Amer Fort: The royal hilltop fort, best for photo shoot
Nahargarh Fort & Palaces: Offering panoramic views of the entire Jaipur city

As evening approaches, immerse yourself in an authentic Rajasthani culture with a delicious dinner at a local resort. Enjoy the vibrant folk music, cultural dance performances, and the delightful rural atmosphere.
Relax and unwind with an overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day :02 – Jaipur Departure
After having your Breakfast, now it is time for departure. A cab will drop you at Jaipur Airport / Railway Station. (The Tour Ends)

Upon the time of arrival at Udaipur Railway Station or Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you and you can head towards your hotel. After refreshing at the hotel, we will begin our tour of Udaipur with visits to:
City Palace: A grand palace with spectacular architecture and a rich history
Fateh Sagar Lake: A peaceful and picturesque lake
Jagdish Temple: An antique temple devoted to Lord Vishnu
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: A museum showcasing Rajasthani folk art and culture
Saheliyon ki Bari: A beautiful garden decorated with fountains and marble pavilions
Shilpgram: A rural arts and crafts complex
As the evening sets in, enjoy adelightful boat ride on PicholaLake, an experience that will go beyond your expectations.
Relax and unwind with an overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
